title: alianza ukax t’unjäwiruw jawillt’äna
intro: Revelación ukamp pachpa teja manqhan imantatäkasmas ukham amuytʼañäni, ukampis yaqha chiqa chuymanïñ ajllïta. Aka jaqix chiqa yatichäwimp profetjam jak’an jakasïna, ukampis khitinakatix jan iyawsapkän ukanakaruw kutt’äna. Jupanakan sarnaqäwipax mä jach’a iwxt’äwjamaw sayt’i, chiqapar jak’achasiñakix janiw mä almarux qhispiykaspati, khititix confianza ukar aljantaski.
clues: Nayax mä profetan utapan jakasiyäta, jupax Allah ukan ajllitänwa.
Chachajajj kuna cheqa yatichäwinaktï yatiykäna uk yatjjayätwa, ukampis janiw cheqpach creykayätti.
Nayajj jaqenakar jan iyawsirinakapar saytʼasa ukat jupa contra yanaptʼasajj atinisitap aljantawayta.
Nayax yaqha profetan chachapampi chikaw arsusipxitu jupax aljantarakitaynawa, jan iyawsirinakatakix mä uñacht’äwiw.
Nayan sarnaqäwijax Surah At-Tahrim ukanx mä iwxt’awiwa, profetanakamp parientenakax janiw kuna jark’aqasiñs churkiti.
Nayax jan wali luririnakamp chikaw jiwawayta, kunapachatix Allah jupax Lut markar t’unjäna, khitinakatix qhiparapki ukanakamp jaytatäna.

arabic: ضَرَبَ ٱللَّهُ مَثَلًۭا لِّلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ ٱمْرَأَتَ نُوحٍۢ وَٱمْرَأَتَ لُوطٍۢ ۖ كَانَتَا تَحْتَ عَبْدَيْنِ مِنْ عِبَادِنَا صَـٰلِحَيْنِ فَخَانَتَاهُمَا فَلَمْ يُغْنِيَا عَنْهُمَا مِنَ ٱللَّهِ شَيْـًۭٔا وَقِيلَ ٱدْخُلَا ٱلنَّارَ مَعَ ٱلدَّٰخِلِينَ
verse: Allāh presents an example of those who disbelieved: the wife of Noah and the wife of Lot. They were under two of Our righteous servants but betrayed them, so they [i.e., those prophets] did not avail them from Allāh at all, and it was said, "Enter the Fire with those who enter." (66:10)
